Authored the p-form symmetry definition and conditional character theorem, plus the Maxwell magnetic-line and finite \(S_3\) examples. Both A/B pages have frontmatter only and empty Markdown bodies.

All four items have current Step 1 `ready` records. Their dependency levels are **1, 2, 2, and 3**, matching the current suppliers.

The p-form definition now depends directly on the codimension-general defect definition. I flagged that cross-batch edge correction for owner review: the interface definition covers codimension one, while p-form symmetry defects can have higher codimension. The assigned page requirement remains unchanged. The Maxwell example derives its character directly from integer flux, without assuming the abstract theorem’s bounded-operator hypotheses for the line.
